blocks.text: Dennis Trillo lashed out at Gelli de Belen after she shared her two cents on the controversy involving his wife, Jennylyn Mercado, and her former partner, Patrick Garcia. During her guest appearance on the Oct. 2 episode of the talk show “Chika Cart,” de Belen was asked for her reaction after she was shown photos and clips of how the issue became a big topic of conversation this week. “Hindi kailangang maging ganito kalaki kasi the reason why this was brought up was because nasasaktan ‘yung anak ni Patrick,” de Belen said.
